cousin-in-law of FMY

The Mr Moore mentioned in the 1840s is assumed to be Stephen Roger Moore, who married (Otterbourne 1823) FMY\'s first cousin Mary Kingsman (b.c. 1785).

They evidently lived in or near Otterbourne.
